quote.text:
Had a client call this morning, and they were genuinely excited about the animations I made for the project.

He said the team was calling me an “animation expert” and wanted to know how I created everything.

I told him to guess, he laughed and said, “Lottie?”

Nope. I told him I used Midjourney.
He couldn’t believe it.

Little reminder: clients care about speed and results. They rarely care about how you got there.

An animation that would’ve taken 2–5 days normally was prompted in under 10 minutes with great creative direction. 

Real world example of how AI is changing my workflow
